sequence.block:
// Configure Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x028, 0x00000000); // Set Circular Buffer mode Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x034, 0x00000000); // Watermark: Set threshold vacancy to 0 to use full buffer ffcrValue = Read32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304); ffcrValue |= 0x00000003; // FFCR: Enable Formatter and Trigger Insertion ffcrValue |= 0x00000400; // FFCR: Insert trigger marker on flush completion (TrigFl) ffcrValue |= 0x00001020; // Flush and Stop Formatter on Trigger (FOnTrig + StopFl) Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x304, ffcrValue); Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x308, ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___PSCR_CircularBuffer); // Set PSCR Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x018, 0x00000000); // Init RwP Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x014, 0x00000000); // Init RRP
Write32(ETF___INSTANCE_INDEX___ADDRESS + 0x020, 0x00000001); // Enable ETF
